title: Creative Strategy & Briefs: Summer + NFL 2026
subtitle: Ad Creative Direction
description: Creative briefs and strategy for paid media ad creative across Summer 2026 and NFL season campaigns.
body:
## Creative Briefs Delivered

All 8 deliverables complete. Full brief at [OTH-25#document-creative-brief](/OTH/issues/OTH-25#document-creative-brief).

**What was built:**

- **World Cup 2026** — positioning one-liner, target persona (Casual Marcus), full H-V-P-CTA framework, 6 hook variants with format assignments, TikTok/Reels and Meta static angles
- **NBA Finals** — 4 hooks, 3 creative angles, group chat / expert-identity / community creative directions
- **Summer UGC/Creator Brief** — 6 content types to encourage, full talking points list, compliance guardrails (what NOT to say)
- **Best Ball Draft Season** — positioning angles, 6 hooks, emotional trigger map (FOMO, pride, simplicity, bragging rights, peer competition)
- **Pick-em Props (NFL)** — 4 hooks, value props, proof points, state availability angle
- **NFL Creator/Influencer Brief** — 4-tier strategy (nano → macro) with content priorities by phase (pre-season vs. regular season), FTC/compliance requirements
- **Testing Plan** — 5 Summer hypotheses + 4 NFL hypotheses, each with A/B design, primary metric, and decision rule
- **Creative Fatigue Monitoring** — trigger thresholds, refresh cadence, weekly scorecard workflow

**Key creative bets made:**
- Peer recommendation framing as the default hook architecture (over brand voice)
- "Casual Marcus" as primary World Cup persona vs. hardcore sports bettor
- Best Ball positioned on simplicity + payoff over complexity/skill
- Creator tiers mapped to content type, not just reach
- Fatigue monitoring tied to hard CTR/frequency thresholds, not intuition
